summaries.products-maintainer: Works on a product (a real checkout) in `products/` and brings it to green before a push: its checks, its pipeline on this machine, a worktree for a branch, a backup
summaries.products-workflow: How work is done in `products/`: see what is declared, check, run the pipeline locally, push when green; every command with its flags, the settings keys
summaries.products-check: `/products-check <product> [checks]`: prints the plan, runs the declared checks and says what is red and why
summaries.products-green-gate: A new session that runs a product's checks and its pipeline on this machine and reports green or red
